name: agentops-harness
description: AgentOps — a local-first operating harness for running coding agents (Claude Code / Codex / Gemini) through an Issue Contract -> PR -> Eval -> Repair -> Release loop.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && cd ../.. && vitest run --config apps/agentops/vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner
scripts.test:postgres: cd ../.. && node -e "if (!process.env.AGENTOPS_TEST_DATABASE_URL) { console.error('AGENTOPS_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required'); process.exit(1) }" && vitest run --config apps/agentops/vitest.config.ts --configLoader runner --no-file-parallelism apps/agentops/test/control-store.integration.test.ts apps/agentops/test/release-receipt-store.integration.test.ts apps/agentops/test/release-projection.integration.test.ts
